sources.launches: data from GCAT (J. McDowell, planet4589.org/space/gcat), CC-BY
sources.prices: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (used locally only)

data_policy: Only derived statistics are published: CARs, CAR variances, abnormal returns, residual volatility and CAR correlations. No raw prices, raw returns, alphas or betas.

parity_tolerances.units: CARs are fractions (0.01 = 1%); tolerance applies to the raw numbers
